meta.title: Spring Boneアニメーション処理の最適化: 親子関係チェックのキャッシュ
meta.body_summary: Attempt to optimize Spring Bone animation by caching parent-child bone relationships, but self-provided cProfile benchmark shows no improvement (202.010s vs 202.048s) and even a slight increase; PR is closed after agent concludes caching overhead cancelled out benefits.

perf_labels.notes: Devin attempted caching optimization with self-provided cProfile benchmark showing no gain; PR self-closed after realizing overhead negated benefits.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 22 changed lines, this is a tiny edit by absolute volume. It represents a small experimental performance PR that was closed because the optimization proved ineffective.

review_details.concern_detail: The optimization added caching of parent-child bone relationships, but profiling showed no improvement (202.010s vs 202.048s) and even a slight increase; the PR was closed because the caching overhead cancelled any benefit.
review_details.performance_claim: Caching parent-child checks to reduce repeated parent chain traversals, expecting speedup for complex bone hierarchies.
review_details.rejection_signals: Self-assessed negative benchmark results; PR closed by maintainer without merge.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The agent attempted a caching optimization but failed to achieve performance improvement, demonstrating that algorithmic changes require empirical validation; the agent provided benchmark evidence and self-concluded the approach was ineffective.

detection_detail.code_reading: No human review; detection solely based on agent-provided profiling.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR includes cProfile output for comparison but does not provide the specific test model or input data, so exact reproduction requires the same scene setup.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After the agent's benchmark showed no improvement, the PR was closed by the maintainer without further changes.

core_change_summary.description: In handler.py, added a bones_with_parent_ids dictionary cache at function start to precompute parent-child relationships, then used it to check if a joint pair's head bone is a parent of the target bone, replacing repeated parent-chain traversal.
change_trajectory: Single commit (ed56b10) added caching logic in calculate_spring_pose_bone_rotations, with benchmark data showing no net improvement.

review_signals.summary: Devin bot announced automatic comment/CI assistance for write-access users.
Devin stated it is archived and cannot be woken up, appearing right before PR closure.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with self-contained benchmark and no external review requests.
Two bot comments appeared, including an archive notice.
Maintainer quickly closed the PR within 3 minutes, likely based on the agent's own negative assessment.
